test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

The actor along with his new wife __is expected__ shortly.
solution:
The correct answer is **No substitution required**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When two subjects are linked by words like '**along with**', '**together with**', '**as well as**', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Therefore, we use **is** or **was,** or **has** instead of **are**, **were,** or **have**.

 
 
• *Example- The director **along with** his wife **has** come to our house.*
 
• Example- He **as well as** his daughter **sings** well. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This is known as subject-verb-agreement of a sentence where the **subjects and verbs agree with each other in terms of number** (singular or plural).
 
• If the subject of a sentence is **singular** the verb of that sentence should also be **singular**.
 
• If the subject of a sentence is plural the verb of that sentence should also be plural.
 
• There are many subject-verb-agreement rules in English Grammar.
